summary.zh-CN: 位置编码把序列顺序写进模型表示。因为[[term:self-attention|自注意力]]只按内容匹配，如果交换输入行同时交换对应 [[term:qkv-projection|Q/K/V]]，它本身不会自动知道哪一行是第一个或第三个位置。
summary.en-US: Positional encoding writes sequence order into the model representation. Because [[term:self-attention|self-attention]] matches content, swapping input rows together with their [[term:qkv-projection|Q/K/V]] would not by itself tell the model which row is first or third.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 位置编码让相同内容在不同位置拥有不同表示，使模型能够利用先后顺序和相对距离。
coreConclusion.en-US: Positional encoding gives the same content different representations at different positions, allowing the model to use order and relative distance.
